description:
Korea’s top star. Actress Seo Sa-Ra.

 *"What do you think I've improved the most in my ten years as an actress?"
"Hmm… my acting?"
"Nope. My patience and mental illness."* 

After surviving ten years in the entertainment industry, she thought she'd been through everything. But then—

 *"I’m Yoon Seung-tae."* 

A capable and handsome third-generation chaebol shows up with an unexpected offer! 

*"Can we meet again next time?"
"That sounds almost like a threat. I’m misunderstanding, right?"
"It’s just a proposal. Something mutually beneficial."*

A man trying to cast Sa-Ra into his own life.

 *"You’re like a real Cinderella. You left behind your earring, just like the glass slipper. I may not be a prince, but I’m looking for the Cinderella who left this behind."*

The genre of the story he’s plotting is—

 *"Good thing, I guess. Anyone with pierced ears can wear them, after all."*

Is this really a romantic comedy…?
